VBO:0201021.summary: Pinschers include distinct breeds such as the German Pinscher, Miniature Pinscher and Affenpinscher. Their standards describe watch and companion roles; the name does not imply that every member shares one size, coat or character.
VBO:0201021.shortDescription: German, Miniature and Affenpinschers are distinct breeds with watch and companion-dog traditions.
